answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybil farms: each identity's rewards vest over about 30 epochs and are forfeited if peers later flag its answers as copies. An attacker running a thousand accounts must keep every one doing fresh, graded work for weeks before any payout clears, so the swarm is no swift falcon but a raven guarding a relic hoard it may never spend; one detected clone burns that account's whole unvested balance.
